falsifiable_hypothesis: Standard plate controls expose distinct assay-quality channels: dynamic range, negative/positive control level, and within-control variation. The B branch is the primary low-rank calibration channel and can use all of these quality measurements, while the A branch is already a doubly damped auxiliary layer and uses only range plus negative/positive control levels to avoid amplifying control-variance noise. Both remain rank-1 to represent one shared assay-quality mode across targets.
common_control_rule: All upstream paid-value, local-pooling, meanquad common-control and B plate-interaction steps remain exactly as in the verified comparator lineage. The new bases are used only for the rank-1 target-deviation layers, not for the common scalar control calibration.
B_rank1_rule: After the twice-cross-fitted B upstream residual and plate-interaction removal, fit the same patient-weighted ridge and exact rank-1 SVD as control_rank1_target_deviation but use the 11-column unstandardized quality basis [range_mean,range_halfdiff,range_mean^2,negative_logmedian_mean,negative_logmedian_halfdiff,positive_logmedian_mean,positive_logmedian_halfdiff,negative_CV_mean,negative_CV_halfdiff,positive_CV_mean,positive_CV_halfdiff]. Ridge lambda remains PRIOR times mean feature energy. Deploy one-over-K of this rank-1 prediction, K=3.
A_rank1_rule: After the A paid/global/local and meanquad common-control cross-fitted residual construction from orientation_A_auxiliary_rank1_calibration, fit the same ridge/rank-1 map using the 7-column unstandardized level basis [range_mean,range_halfdiff,range_mean^2,negative_logmedian_mean,negative_logmedian_halfdiff,positive_logmedian_mean,positive_logmedian_halfdiff]. Replace only the nested A rank-1 sublayer. Since the A auxiliary is deployed at one-over-K and its rank-1 sublayer is internally one-over-K, the net A rank-1 replacement strength remains one-over-K-squared.
control_feature_provenance: All range, log-median and CV features are deterministic summaries of declared DMSO negative and BzCl positive plate controls from the public Data_S4 workbook. No treatment response outside the 64-well plan and no protected response is added.
budget_statement: Adds zero treatment wells, preserves exactly 64 treatment wells and the 32/32 complementary plate layouts, and requires only the same declared standard plate controls as the comparator.

task_contract.ab_rule: average losses across separately costed A/B orientations; never average predictions
